# Claudopus

> Claudopus is a free, open-source (MIT) mod for Claude Code, Anthropic's coding agent, for macOS and Linux. Each message you send in a chat becomes a task that Claude runs in the background, so the chat is free for your next message straight away. A panel beside the chat shows every task as a card, questions that need you come to the top of it, and what each finished task found is kept in a Results list. Claudopus is not made by Anthropic.

- Website: https://www.claudopus.ai
- Source code: https://github.com/dimka3553/claudopus
- Latest release: https://github.com/dimka3553/claudopus/releases/latest
- Licence: MIT

## Install

At the Claude Code prompt:

```
/plugin marketplace add dimka3553/claudopus
/plugin install claudopus@claudopus
```

Then `/claudopus` opens the panel. In the Claude desktop app: + next to the prompt box, Plugins, Add marketplace `dimka3553/claudopus`, then add `claudopus`.

## What it does

- One chat runs many tasks at once: each request is its own background task, and the chat stays small because the work happens in the tasks.
- The panel shows each task's to-dos, how far it has got, its helpers and its long commands; Stop ends a task.
- Questions, permission prompts and releases from every chat wait at the top of the panel with answer buttons, a sound and a notification.
- Results keeps what each finished task found, with its pictures, as plain files on your machine.
- Memory keeps your messages word for word and notes on each topic, so later chats can look them up.
- A second agent that did not do the work can check it before you see it.
- Tasks that run side by side use tokens side by side: five at once use them about five times as fast as one.
